title: Alarms, composite alarms and notification through SNS

videos.script: An alarm has one job. Wake the right person when customers are hurting, and nobody when they are not. {{job}} The threshold is the part everybody sets. The other four numbers decide whether it works. How many minutes to look at. How many must be bad. And what a minute with no data counts as. {{numbers}} This lesson publishes ten minutes of errors that should fire an alarm. moto never evaluates alarms, so a short program does, following the rules AWS documents. {{model}} And it finds the alarm that went quiet when the service died. No data, counted as good. The worst minute of the hour, read as recovery. {{quiet}} Then the route from alarm to person: a topic, and the subscriptions behind it. And composite alarms, which page on what customers feel, not on every cause. {{route}} By the end, you can read an alarm's five numbers and say what will wake you, and what never will. {{end}}
